lines.t: Let the trumpet be blown loudly, let the call to repentance go out, behold the trumpet call
of God, come all nations to the ensign raised high.
A standard lifted
The sleepers wake
The light shines bright
The hearts shall quake
A banner waving, the glory unfurls
The King of Heaven calling all the world
From Zion's hill the trumpet sounds
The word of Yahushua spreads all around
A warning, a call, a beacon bright
To draw the faithful into His light
Be a part of the trumpet call
Hear the word, the banner for all
Step forward, beloved, take your stand
Join the call across the land
Yahushua, Yahuwah, reigns on high
The trumpet sounds
Redemption night
The nations stir
The plumb line falls
The righteous rise
As judgment calls
A bright lamp holds
A shining flame
proclaim the trumpet call proclaims his name thus says the lord beloved this word even every
volume to every letter is the word of my glory which i have put forth once again a testament
of my love and sacrifice the announcement of my coming a proclamation of truth revelation
of who I really am, the trumpet call of God, so all those called and chosen may hear and come to
me in their proper time and season. Behold, it is also a strong correction for all those who have
taken to themselves my name and my word, to pollute it, a plumb line for this wicked generation,
for this word is a waving banner, an incense to all nations, a trumpet of alarm and war,
The sound of recompense and judgment which shall soon fall upon every nation
For I am who I am, the only begotten of the Father
The one true God and Savior, the Mashiach
Be a part of the trumpet call
Hear the word, the banner for all
Step forward, beloved, take your stand
Join the call across the land
And Yahushua, Yahuwah, reigns on high
The trumpet sounds
Redemption night
Come, take your place
And the trumpet calls
For behold, the King comes
